## Product Requirements Document

Product Requirements Document (PRD): ExperienceLink
1. Overview

Product Name: ExperienceLink
Authors: Nate Irizarry, Diego Camacho Salgado
Date: October 2025
Status: Draft

ExperienceLink is a modern, responsive web platform that connects students with companies through short-term, real-world project opportunities. It allows students to gain career-relevant experience and build portfolios for future internships while helping companies complete small projects and discover potential talent.

2. Background / Context

Problem:
Many students struggle to get relevant career experience because most internships require prior experience — creating a “catch-22.” At the same time, companies have small, real-world tasks that could be done by skilled students but lack a simple way to connect with them.


Opportunity:
ExperienceLink bridges this gap by providing a structured platform for companies to post short-term projects and for students to gain practical experience, develop skills, and enhance their resumes.

3. Objectives & Success Metrics
Objective	Metric	Target
Help students gain experience	Number of projects completed	100+ projects in first 3 months
Increase student engagement	Active student accounts	60% monthly retention
Attract companies to post projects	Number of registered companies	50+ in first quarter
Deliver smooth UX	Page load time	<2 seconds on mobile and desktop

4. User Stories / Use Cases
•	For Students:
•	As a student, I want to browse projects so I can find opportunities that match my skills.
•	As a student, I want to apply to a project so I can gain experience.
•	As a student, I want to upload completed work so companies can evaluate it.
•	As a student, I want to build a profile showing my skills and completed projects.
•	For Companies:
•	As a company, I want to post new projects so students can apply.
•	As a company, I want to review applicants and view their profiles.
•	As a company, I want to leave feedback on student work.
•	For Admin:
•	As an admin, I want to verify company accounts to ensure legitimacy.
•	As an admin, I want to manage users and approve project listings.

5. Functional Requirements
•	Home Page
•	Simple, modern landing page with a clear explanation of the platform.
•	Prominent call-to-action buttons: “I’m a Student” and “I’m a Company.”
•	Navigation bar with links: Home | Projects | Companies | About | Login.
•	Student Dashboard
•	Student sign-up/login with email and password.
•	Browse a list of projects with filters (skills, duration, company).
•	Each project card displays company name, task title, short description, required skills, and duration/reward.
•	Clicking a card shows full details and buttons: “Apply” or “Submit Work.”
•	Company Dashboard
•	Company sign-up/login with email and password.
•	Form to post new projects (fields: title, description, skills, duration, reward).
•	View list of applicants and access their profiles.
•	Student Profile Page
•	Displays student info: name, university, bio, skills, completed projects, feedback.
•	Option to upload a profile photo.
•	Editable via profile settings.
•	Admin/Verification Section (optional MVP+)
•	Approve new companies before posting access.
•	Manage reported or inactive projects.

6. Non-Functional Requirements
Category	Requirement
Performance	Pages should load within 2 seconds.
Responsiveness	Must work seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Accessibility	Follow WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
Security	Use Firebase Auth for secure login and user data protection.
Scalability	Structure backend for easy migration from Firebase to a full database (e.g., MongoDB).

7. Design / UI
- Clean, minimal layout using Tailwind CSS.
- Consistent color scheme (light neutral background with accent blue).
- Modern typography (e.g., Inter or Roboto).
- Responsive grid layout for cards and dashboards.
- Mockup pages: Home, Student Dashboard, Company Dashboard, Profile, Login/Signup.

8. Dependencies / Risks
Dependency	Risk	Mitigation
Firebase Authentication	Integration issues	Start with demo login and add Firebase later
React & Tailwind setup	Compatibility or build errors	Use create-react-app template
Company verification	Possible fake accounts	Manual admin approval or verification email
Database structure	Data complexity	Start with Firebase, migrate later to SQL/Mongo if needed

9. Timeline / Milestones
Milestone	Target Date	Owner
Design Wireframes	Nov 5, 2025	UX/UI
MVP Frontend Build	Nov 20, 2025	Frontend Dev
Backend Integration	Dec 1, 2025	Backend Dev
Internal Testing	Dec 10, 2025	QA
Beta Launch	Dec 20, 2025	PM / Team
Public Demo Release	Jan 2026	All

10. Open Questions / Future Considerations
•	Should projects include compensation (money, gift cards, or credit)?
•	Should companies be able to message students directly on the platform?
•	Add project reviews or ratings for quality assurance?
•	Should the admin panel include analytics (e.g., top skills, popular projects)?
•	Future feature: AI skill matching between students and projects.
